Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

konstats (development version)

  • install_course() installs from R-universe as well as the repositories set in getOption("repos"), so it finds simling, which is not on CRAN. check_setup() suggests installing simling from R-universe.
  • Each Statistics exercise sheet names the chapters of Winter (2019) it goes with and ends with the full reference. The README and the package help say that the examples and data sets of the course are new and that the course is not endorsed by Winter or Routledge.

konstats 0.2.0

  • konstats is an open course in statistics for linguists, which is also taught at the University of Konstanz.
  • The packages of both courses are in Suggests, so installing konstats no longer installs them. install_course() installs the packages of a course and now defaults to "statistics"; install.packages("konstats", dependencies = TRUE) installs the packages of both courses.
  • check_setup() suggests install.packages("simling") when simling is too old for a course.
  • cv_speakers() uses rlang::check_installed(), which offers to install ranger when it is missing.
  • Examples and tests run without the suggested packages.
  • partial_dependence() stops with an error for values that are not levels of a factor, for data without rows and for empty values. It used to return wrong or NaN predictions.
  • resid_acf() stops with an error for residuals that are not numeric and for groups with missing values.
  • cv_speakers(), theme_paper(), get_tutorial() and install_course() check their arguments and say plainly what is wrong.
  • check_setup() returns a tibble without names on its columns.
  • The exercise sheets are licensed under CC BY 4.0, as stated in inst/COPYRIGHTS.
  • The help pages cite Winter (2019) and Friedman (2001) with their DOIs.
  • The Advanced Statistics exercise sheets are Quarto documents (.qmd), like the slides of the course. tutorials() and get_tutorial() handle both .qmd and .Rmd sheets; the Statistics sheets are still R Markdown.

konstats 0.1.0

  • konstats can be installed from R-universe (https://mcanzi.r-universe.dev).
  • First version.
  • Installing konstats installs the packages of the Statistics course; install_course("advanced") installs the extra packages of Advanced Statistics, and course_packages() lists them all.
  • check_setup() checks the version of R, the packages of a course and that simling has the data sets its slides use.
  • lectures() lists the lectures of both courses with the chapters of Winter
    1. they follow, the data sets they use and their slides; slides() opens the slides of a lecture.
  • tutorials() lists the exercise sheets and get_tutorial() copies them into a project folder, one at a time or all at once with get_tutorial("all", dir). Sheets for Statistics tutorials 1 to 12 (tutorial 1 is guided, with all the code), and for the tutorials of the practical lectures of Advanced Statistics (4, 6, 9 and 11).
  • An R Markdown template for the weekly assignments.
  • The helpers of the Advanced Statistics slides: resid_acf() (residual autocorrelation within trajectories), partial_dependence() (called partial() in the slides), cv_speakers() (cross-validation of a random forest by speaker, with the folds of the slides) and theme_paper().
  • Hex logo: a Bodensee forget-me-not, in the blue of the University of Konstanz and the forest colours of mcanzi.de.
